project_name: Suzuki 2-Wheeler Spare Parts DMS & ERP Command Center

theme_strategy.philosophy: Crisp industrial precision tailored for Indian B2B automotive parts distribution. High-contrast tabular clarity with dense ergonomic data layouts, instant Indian Rupee formatting (₹), HSN GST categorization, multi-state DMS allocation workflows, and visual discrepancy alerts (>1% MRP diff flag, allocated-not-received badges).

entry_surfaces./: industrial command dashboard with process-step tabbar, quick action metrics ribbon, and split inventory-allocation workbench
entry_surfaces./login: compact split staff portal with Suzuki Genuine Parts branding on left and shared quick-PIN/credential form on right

tabs.label: Masters & Items
tabs.description: Parts Catalog (Part No, HSN, MRP, Alt Part No) & Customers (GST, Wholesaler/Retailer, Dealer Code, Discount %, MOQ)

tabs.label: Price List & NDP Formula
tabs.description: NDP upload with automatic MRP formula (NDP * 1.18 / 0.78), tag MRP validation

tabs.label: Customer Orders & Quotation
tabs.description: Upload customer Excel orders, auto quotation generation with live MRP and alternate part fallback

tabs.label: Stock Allocation
tabs.description: Interactive tick-to-allocate warehouse stock to customer orders, split ready-to-bill vs balance

tabs.label: GST Invoicing & E-Way / IRN
tabs.description: Generate GST invoices (Tag MRP based, HSN breakdown, Customer discount), Bill to Different Customer toggle, simulated/live E-Invoice (IRN) and E-Way Bill generation API

tabs.label: Balance Orders & DMS PO
tabs.description: Balance parts from unfilled orders, voluntary qty column, auto PO# & Ref#, DMS-ready Excel export

tabs.label: Vendor Invoices & GRN
tabs.description: Upload vendor invoices, allocated-not-received tracking, tag-MRP entry with >1% variance alert flag, approve into stock

tabs.label: Short Received Report
tabs.description: Track vendor short supplies, auto removal upon vendor resupply

tabs.label: Warehouse Stock
tabs.description: Real-time stock on hand, bin locations, reserved vs free stock

tabs.label: 14-Day Stock Predictor
tabs.description: Tally invoice history analysis, 14-day retailer buffer rounded to MOQ, auto PO generation

tabs.label: Firm X ↔ Y Reconciliation
tabs.description: Company billed to Firm X vs sold by Firm Y reconciliation report and next-month billing queue

layout_and_density_rules.grid_strategy: High Density Grid (MODE B) - 100% data visibility, sticky table headers, compact row height (h-10 / py-2)
layout_and_density_rules.table_style: border border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800 rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 shadow-xs
layout_and_density_rules.number_formatting: Locale: en-IN (e.g., ₹1,24,500.00, ₹850.00), right-aligned numeric columns with tabular nums font-mono
layout_and_density_rules.excel_handling: Dedicated drag-and-drop Excel upload zone with sample template download button for Parts, Customers, Customer Orders, and Vendor Invoices

motion_and_micro_interactions.transitions: transition-colors duration-150 ease-out, transition-transform duration-150 ease-out
motion_and_micro_interactions.allocation_checkbox: tactile bounce and instantaneous row highlight color shift when ticked
motion_and_micro_interactions.toast_notifications: Sonner bottom-right toast with richColors for instant feedback on Excel uploads, allocation saves, and IRN generations

accessibility.contrast_standard: WCAG AA (4.5:1 minimum on all text against respective solid/glass surfaces)
accessibility.keyboard_navigation: Full arrow-key and tab-key traversal across data tables and allocation checkboxes
accessibility.data_testids: Strict kebab-case data-testid on every tab button, action button, input, checkbox, table row, and modal trigger

image_urls.description: Two-wheeler motorcycle workshop and spare parts tuning station
image_urls.placement: Login screen visual panel and branding header watermark

formula_specifications.ndp_to_mrp: MRP = NDP * 1.18 / 0.78 (where NDP is Net Dealer Price, 1.18 represents 18% GST baseline, 0.78 accounts for dealer margin factor)
formula_specifications.mrp_variance_alert: flag when abs(purchase_mrp - tag_mrp) / tag_mrp > 0.01 (1% threshold) — visually mark row in Rose/Red (#BE123C) with badge 'MRP Discrepancy > 1%' and trigger vendor claim note option
formula_specifications.stocking_14day: 14-day stock requirement = ceil((total_sales_in_period / days_in_period) * 14 / moq) * moq

e_invoicing_and_eway_mock.mode: Provider adapter pattern with Live / Simulated toggle in UI
e_invoicing_and_eway_mock.simulated_features: Generate 64-character alphanumeric IRN (Invoice Reference Number), signed QR code mockup, Acknowledgement Number & Date, and 12-digit E-Way Bill Number with Validity date and transporter vehicle details
e_invoicing_and_eway_mock.gst_invoice_print: Complete printable / downloadable GST Tax Invoice format including: Seller GSTIN, Buyer GSTIN, Invoice No, HSN Summary table (HSN Code, Taxable Value, CGST Rate%, CGST Amt, SGST Rate%, SGST Amt, Total), Discount applied, Tag MRP, Net Payable, and IRN barcode

excel_parser_and_exporter.library: pandas / openpyxl on backend + client-side XLSX export helper with sample templates for instant download

shared_staff_login.design: Clean, quick PIN or username/password staff switcher with predefined roles: Staff, Store Manager, Billing Clerk, and Owner, allowing smooth one-click fast switching in development/demo mode
